_meta.behavior: DATA ONLY. No module reads these rules yet. Wiring the safety classifier is OUT OF SCOPE for this PR. WHEN BUILT, the safety layer must be the most conservative module and able to override all others.
_meta.purpose: Encodes the traffic-light escalation ladder and red-flag list for a future SafetyModule.

traffic_light.action: reduce intensity, volume, or ROM; substitute to a pain-free variation; ask targeted questions

traffic_light.meaning: Stop and route to medical evaluation — not a coaching problem
signals: chest pain/pressure/tightness (esp. with radiation to arm/jaw, shortness of breath, nausea, cold sweats)
joint instability, obvious deformity, severe swelling, inability to bear weight
fever / viral illness for normal training
traffic_light.action: stop; advise qualified medical evaluation; do not coach through; do not diagnose

safe_defaults.onboarding_screen: PAR-Q / CSEP Get Active Questionnaire style
safe_defaults.confidence_inversion: Low confidence about a possible red flag triggers MORE caution, never less.
